tables.name: SpeckleMatchIndex
tables.expression:
VAR Identities = DISTINCT(SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(SpeckleElements, NOT ISBLANK(SpeckleElements[properties.Element.Id]) && TRIM(SpeckleElements[properties.Element.Id] & "") <> "" && SpeckleElements[Model Key] <> ""), "ModelKey", SpeckleElements[Model Key] & "", "ElementId", TRIM(SpeckleElements[properties.Element.Id] & ""), "Identity", COALESCE(SpeckleElements[properties.Source File], "") & "|" & COALESCE(SpeckleElements[properties.UniqueId], "OBJECT:" & FORMAT(SpeckleElements[Object Key], "0"))))
RETURN GROUPBY(Identities, [ModelKey], [ElementId], "CandidateCount", COUNTX(CURRENTGROUP(), 1))

tables.name: Clash3DSides
tables.expression:
VAR Sides = UNION(
SELECTCOLUMNS(CurrentClashes,"ClashKey",CurrentClashes[3D Clash Key],"Side","A","ModelKey",CurrentClashes[3D A Model Key] & "","ElementId",TRIM(CurrentClashes[ItemAElementId] & ""),"ItemPath",CurrentClashes[ItemAPath]),
SELECTCOLUMNS(CurrentClashes,"ClashKey",CurrentClashes[3D Clash Key],"Side","B","ModelKey",CurrentClashes[3D B Model Key] & "","ElementId",TRIM(CurrentClashes[ItemBElementId] & ""),"ItemPath",CurrentClashes[ItemBPath]))
VAR Counts = SELECTCOLUMNS(SpeckleMatchIndex,"ModelKey",SpeckleMatchIndex[ModelKey] & "","ElementId",SpeckleMatchIndex[ElementId] & "","CandidateCount",SpeckleMatchIndex[CandidateCount])
RETURN ADDCOLUMNS(NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(Sides,Counts),"MatchStatus",SWITCH(TRUE(),[ElementId]="","Missing element ID",[ModelKey]="","Missing source model",ISBLANK([CandidateCount]),"Model / ID not found",[CandidateCount]>1,"Ambiguous source identity - excluded","Matched model + ID"))

tables.name: Clash3DGeometry
tables.expression:
VAR Sides = SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(Clash3DSides,Clash3DSides[CandidateCount]=1),"ClashKey",Clash3DSides[ClashKey],"Side",Clash3DSides[Side],"ModelKey",Clash3DSides[ModelKey] & "","ElementId",Clash3DSides[ElementId] & "")
VAR Geometry = SELECTCOLUMNS(SpeckleElements,"ModelKey",SpeckleElements[Model Key] & "","ElementId",TRIM(SpeckleElements[properties.Element.Id] & ""),"Object Key",SpeckleElements[Object Key],"SourceFile",SpeckleElements[properties.Source File],"UniqueId",SpeckleElements[properties.UniqueId],"Model Info",LOOKUPVALUE(Objects[Model Info],Objects[Object Key],SpeckleElements[Object Key]))
RETURN NATURALINNERJOIN(Sides,Geometry)

measures.name: 3D Match Summary
measures.expression: VAR N = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Clash3DSides), Clash3DSides[CandidateCount] = 1) RETURN IF([3D Selection Ready] <> 1, "Select one clash", SWITCH(N, 2, "Both elements matched by model + ID", 1, "One element matched only", "No matched elements"))

measures.name: 3D Selection Caption
measures.expression: IF([3D Selection Ready] = 1, [3D Match Summary] & " | " & SELECTEDVALUE(CurrentClashes[ClashGuid]), "Select one clash in the register to load its matched elements in 3D.")

measures.name: 3D A Match
measures.expression: IF([3D Selection Ready] = 1, CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE(Clash3DSides[MatchStatus]), Clash3DSides[Side] = "A"), "Select one clash")

measures.name: 3D A Source
measures.expression: IF([3D Selection Ready] = 1, COALESCE(CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE(Clash3DGeometry[SourceFile]), Clash3DGeometry[Side] = "A"), "No matched element"), "Select one clash")

measures.name: 3D B Match
measures.expression: IF([3D Selection Ready] = 1, CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE(Clash3DSides[MatchStatus]), Clash3DSides[Side] = "B"), "Select one clash")

measures.name: 3D B Source
measures.expression: IF([3D Selection Ready] = 1, COALESCE(CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE(Clash3DGeometry[SourceFile]), Clash3DGeometry[Side] = "B"), "No matched element"), "Select one clash")

calculatedColumns.name: Model Key
calculatedColumns.expression:
VAR RawName = LOWER(TRIM(SpeckleElements[properties.Source File] & ""))
VAR Segments = SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(RawName, "\", "|"), "/", "|")
VAR FileName = IF(Segments = "", "", PATHITEM(Segments, PATHLENGTH(Segments), TEXT))
VAR Stem = IF(RIGHT(FileName,4) IN {".rvt", ".nwc", ".nwd", ".ifc", ".dwg"}, LEFT(FileName, MAX(0,LEN(FileName)-4)), FileName)
RETURN IF(RIGHT(Stem,9) = "_detached", LEFT(Stem,MAX(0,LEN(Stem)-9)), Stem)

calculatedColumns.name: 3D A Model Key
calculatedColumns.expression:
VAR PathHierarchy = SUBSTITUTE(TRIM(CurrentClashes[ItemAPath] & ""), " > ", "|")
VAR NodeCount = IF(PathHierarchy = "",0,PATHLENGTH(PathHierarchy))
VAR FileNodes = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(GENERATESERIES(1,NodeCount), "NodeName", TRIM(PATHITEM(PathHierarchy,[Value],TEXT))), RIGHT(LOWER([NodeName]),4) IN {".rvt", ".nwc", ".nwd", ".ifc", ".dwg"})
VAR LastFile = MAXX(TOPN(1,FileNodes,[Value],DESC),[NodeName])
RETURN VAR RawName = LOWER(TRIM(LastFile & ""))
VAR Segments = SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(RawName, "\", "|"), "/", "|")
VAR FileName = IF(Segments = "", "", PATHITEM(Segments, PATHLENGTH(Segments), TEXT))
VAR Stem = IF(RIGHT(FileName,4) IN {".rvt", ".nwc", ".nwd", ".ifc", ".dwg"}, LEFT(FileName, MAX(0,LEN(FileName)-4)), FileName)
RETURN IF(RIGHT(Stem,9) = "_detached", LEFT(Stem,MAX(0,LEN(Stem)-9)), Stem)

calculatedColumns.name: 3D B Model Key
calculatedColumns.expression:
VAR PathHierarchy = SUBSTITUTE(TRIM(CurrentClashes[ItemBPath] & ""), " > ", "|")
VAR NodeCount = IF(PathHierarchy = "",0,PATHLENGTH(PathHierarchy))
VAR FileNodes = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(GENERATESERIES(1,NodeCount), "NodeName", TRIM(PATHITEM(PathHierarchy,[Value],TEXT))), RIGHT(LOWER([NodeName]),4) IN {".rvt", ".nwc", ".nwd", ".ifc", ".dwg"})
VAR LastFile = MAXX(TOPN(1,FileNodes,[Value],DESC),[NodeName])
RETURN VAR RawName = LOWER(TRIM(LastFile & ""))
VAR Segments = SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(RawName, "\", "|"), "/", "|")
VAR FileName = IF(Segments = "", "", PATHITEM(Segments, PATHLENGTH(Segments), TEXT))
VAR Stem = IF(RIGHT(FileName,4) IN {".rvt", ".nwc", ".nwd", ".ifc", ".dwg"}, LEFT(FileName, MAX(0,LEN(FileName)-4)), FileName)
RETURN IF(RIGHT(Stem,9) = "_detached", LEFT(Stem,MAX(0,LEN(Stem)-9)), Stem)
